verdict.rationale: Mercury Books is explicitly a double-entry accounting system (supp-double-entry) and mentions 'writing journal entries' as a task that can be offloaded to its AI assistant Command (supp-command), implying journal-entry functionality exists, but no evidence details a manual entry screen with balanced debit/credit line items or memo fields for accountant-authored entries. missing for 10: explicit UI/API documentation of manual journal entry creation, debit/credit balancing validation, and memo/note fields on entries.
